business_logic: 1. GET list: paginate sesuai shared-decisions.pagination, filter opsional by station_id, eager-load Station untuk station_name, hitung machinery_count via COUNT machinery WHERE machinery_group_id

2. GET /api/stations/options: SELECT id, name, business_unit_id dari seluruh Station, urut nama, untuk dropdown form (tanpa pagination) — business_unit_id disertakan agar FE dapat menyalin business_unit_id Station terpilih ke Machinery Group secara otomatis (konsistensi hierarki)

3. POST create: validate station_id ada → validate group_code required + unik secara global → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → salin business_unit_id dari Station terpilih → insert Machinery Group baru

4. PATCH update: validate id exists → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → validate station_id ada → validate group_code required + unik global (exclude self) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → salin ulang business_unit_id dari Station terpilih → update Machinery Group
5. DELETE: validate id exists → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → count Machinery WHERE machinery_group_id=id → if count > 0: return 409 MACHINERY_GROUP_HAS_MACHINERY → else delete Machinery Group

UPDATE Machinery Group, business_unit_id disalin ulang dari Station terpilih
DELETE Machinery Group jika tidak ada Machinery terkait
COUNT Machinery WHERE machinery_group_id sebelum delete
